description: Extract English machine-printed text from one caller-supplied PNG, JPEG, or WebP locally with Tesseract. Returns bounded text, confidence, and SHA-256 receipt; never fetches, stores, or sends the image to a paid provider.

image_base64.description: One base64-encoded PNG, JPEG, or WebP image up to 6 MiB decoded; image/* data URIs are accepted.

psm.description: Tesseract page segmentation mode for machine-printed text.

name: extract_image_text
